data.gender_notes: Orren is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'oros', meaning mountain. Orren is a name befitting a strong, rugged individual, much like the terrain it is derived from. The name Orren carries the meaning “Mountain man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Orren usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
